ctaHeading: Brunswick's plumbing pros are here — let's fix it now.
aboutText: Expert Plumbing & Gas Services has been keeping Brunswick homes and businesses running smoothly for years. Based on Sydney Road, we are the trusted local choice for everything from blocked drains and burst pipes to complex gas appliance installations and sustainable hot water systems across Melbourne's inner north.
servicesSubheading: Comprehensive solutions for your home or business
servicesText: We handle all general plumbing, gas fitting, drainage, and hot water system needs. From emergency repairs in Collingwood to planned renovations in Kew, our licensed team delivers expert service tailored to your suburb.

services.title: Drain Clearing & Inspections
services.desc: Expert unblocking for drains, toilets & sewers using CCTV inspections across Brunswick, Fitzroy & Northcote.

services.title: Gas Fitting & Appliances
services.desc: Licensed gas plumbers for installations, repairs & leak detection for cooktops, heaters & more in your local area.

services.title: Hot Water Systems
services.desc: Supply, install & repair all major brands of electric, gas & heat pump hot water systems for Melbourne homes.

services.title: Burst Pipes & Leak Detection
services.desc: Rapid response to burst pipes and water leaks, using advanced detection to minimise damage in your property.

services.title: Commercial & Strata Plumbing
services.desc: Reliable plumbing maintenance and installations for businesses, body corporates & property managers across the city.

services.title: Kitchen & Bathroom Renovations
services.desc: Complete plumbing solutions for new builds and renovations, from roughing-in to final fixture installation.

bannerSubheading: Fast, reliable service from your neighbours on Sydney Road.

reviews.text: The team at Expert Plumbing made replacing our old hot water system in Brunswick seamless. They were on time, tidy, and the new heat pump is running perfectly. Highly recommend their service!

reviews.text: We had a nasty blocked drain at our café in Fitzroy. Expert Plumbing cleared it quickly and professionally, minimising disruption to our business. Their rapid response was a lifesaver.
reviews.name: Tom Henderson

reviews.text: Expert Plumbing handles all our maintenance plumbing for our properties in Northcote and Princes Hill. They are reliable, their pricing is fair, and they understand the specific needs of older buildings.
